A Georgia Power news article (cached as gpc-big-ogeechee-news-2026) says it went online in summer 2026. SERTP 2025 p.75 says it is 'near Little Ogeechee substation' with new 230 kV lines to Little Ogeechee. Little Ogeechee itself is at 32.00679,-81.25315 (OSM way/121701191).

The Bush Road site comes from WTOC, 2025-02-27; the Georgia Power news article (gpc-big-ogeechee-news-2026) and the plan text support it.
endpoints.validation: The plan says the substation is near Little Ogeechee and next to the shared 500kV/230kV right of way. Georgia Power's article says it is in west Chatham County along an existing high-voltage line, with a new line running nearly five miles down Little Neck Road. WTOC reports that line runs from the existing substation on Little Neck Road (Little Ogeechee, at the road's south end) to a new one on Bush Road. Bush Road meets the shared 500/230 kV right of way at this point, about 5.8 km from Little Ogeechee, and the road route is about 5 mi. The exact fenced site is not mapped.
